title: Remove findings from positional session check in Core Non-Model modules
body:
After PR https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/67150 some cleanup. As Airflow Core would be a very large PR, splitting into multiple smaller, this is for:

- Airflow-Core - Secrets
- Airflow-Core - Serialization
- Airflow-Core/Tests - Listeners
